prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that Shanghai trip back in 2025—felt like the city was nonstop energy.
The funny part is we actually went over by train—Beijing to Shanghai—because my friend insisted it was smoother than flying.
I dug up an old screenshot and it said the train was G3, dated 2025-03-21, and the ticket was under Li Na in Second Class.
For the hotel, we ended up at Waldorf Astoria Shanghai on the Bund—honestly the view was the whole point.
It was booked under Liu Yang, check-in was 2025-03-22, and we stayed 3 nights—already all done, just looking back at the details.
